Tuesday.focus: Light, Science and Magic chapter due soonest

Thursday.focus: Deep review — same chapter as Tuesday, reinforce before class

Friday.focus: Halsall or supplementary contemporary art reading

Saturday.focus: Long-form video or deep read — rotate courses

Sunday.focus: Long-form video or deep read — rotate courses

resources.title: Ways of Seeing
resources.author: John Berger
resources.context: Foundational text — semiotics and image theory. Read alongside contemporary art discussions.

resources.title: The Work of Art in the Age of Mechanical Reproduction
resources.author: Walter Benjamin
resources.context: Essential for understanding photographic reproduction and aura. Connects to PHOT 215.

resources.title: In Defense of the Poor Image
resources.author: Hito Steyerl
resources.context: Digital image circulation and value — critical for contemporary art context.

resources.title: Art21 — Artists in Their Own Words
resources.author: Art21
resources.context: Watch one artist episode per week — connects studio practice to contemporary discourse.

resources.title: Tate Talks — Artist Lectures
resources.author: Tate
resources.context: Artist and curator talks — strong theoretical grounding for studio finance context.

resources.title: Frieze — Contemporary Art Criticism
resources.author: Frieze Magazine
resources.context: Read one article per week — keeps you current with contemporary art market and criticism.

resources.title: The Modern Art Notes Podcast
resources.author: Tyler Green
resources.context: Deep dives into contemporary exhibitions and artists — excellent for SFIN 220 discussions.

resources.title: Darkroom Dan — Film Development & Printing
resources.author: Darkroom Dan
resources.context: Practical darkroom technique — watch before each lab session. Developing, dodging, burning.

resources.title: Matt Day — Film Photography Techniques
resources.author: Matt Day
resources.context: Film exposure, metering, and camera operation. Great for reinforcing Sunny 16 rule.

resources.title: Film Photography Project — Resources & Community
resources.author: Film Photography Project
resources.context: Film stock guides, darkroom tutorials, and community discussion. Good reference throughout quarter.

resources.title: Sunny 16 Podcast — Film Photography
resources.author: Sunny 16 Podcast
resources.context: Film community podcast — technique, history, and darkroom culture. Good for long commutes.

resources.title: Khan Academy — History of Photography
resources.author: Khan Academy / Smarthistory
resources.context: Chronological history of photography — daguerreotype through digital. Use as backbone reference.

resources.title: Getty Museum — Photography Collection & Resources
resources.author: Getty Museum
resources.context: Primary source images and curatorial essays — excellent for art history context.

resources.title: The History of Photography
resources.author: Beaumont Newhall
resources.context: Canonical history text — read chronologically alongside course content.

resources.title: On Photography
resources.author: Susan Sontag
resources.context: Critical theory of photography — essential for documentary and representation discussions. Week 5 FSA content aligns with 'Where the Water Holds You'.

resources.title: Camera Lucida
resources.author: Roland Barthes
resources.context: Phenomenology of photography — studium and punctum. Deep read for video essay theoretical grounding.

resources.title: Photo Stories Podcast
resources.author: Photo Stories
resources.context: Photographer interviews and history discussions — good complement to reading assignments.

resources.title: Capture One Tethering Setup — Official Tutorial
resources.author: Capture One
resources.context: REQUIRED before first class Mar 25. Set up tethering workflow before arriving to studio.

resources.title: Light, Science & Magic — Ch 5: Shape & Contour
resources.author: Fil Hunter, Steven Biver, Paul Fuqua
resources.context: Read before Thu Mar 26 class. Focus on how light reveals form and edge.

resources.title: Light, Science & Magic — Ch 7: Glass
resources.author: Fil Hunter, Steven Biver, Paul Fuqua
resources.context: Read before Tue Mar 31 class. Transmission, reflection, and shooting glass objects.

resources.title: Light, Science & Magic — Ch 6: Metal
resources.author: Fil Hunter, Steven Biver, Paul Fuqua
resources.context: Read before Tue Apr 7 class. Polarized light, surface texture, and metallic reflections.

resources.title: Light, Science & Magic — Ch 8: Arsenal of Light
resources.author: Fil Hunter, Steven Biver, Paul Fuqua
resources.context: Read before Tue Apr 28 class. Equipment mastery and light modifier selection.

resources.title: The Slanted Lens — Studio Lighting Tutorials
resources.author: Jay P. Morgan
resources.context: Product and portrait lighting setups — practical complement to Light, Science & Magic chapters.

resources.title: Karl Taylor Photography — Commercial Studio Lighting
resources.author: Karl Taylor
resources.context: Commercial lighting and tethered shooting workflows. Watch after reading LSM chapters.

resources.title: Peter Hurley — The Art Behind the Portrait
resources.author: Peter Hurley
resources.context: Portrait direction and lighting — relevant when course moves to portrait studio work.

resources.title: Lindsay Adler — Fashion & Studio Photography
resources.author: Lindsay Adler
resources.context: Advanced lighting and posing — great for developing personal studio aesthetic.
